assessments.reasoning: SAP’s release 7.54 overview attributes all three properties to the internal table’s type. Row type describes the rows, while category and key characterize the table. The passage leaves category-specific requirements and defaulting outside the finding. All source and excerpt digests in this review were recomputed by opening retained original material and its enrolled PDF text extracts.

challenge.method: Check whether category and key merely describe a particular table instance, or whether the passage assigns them to the type.
challenge.results: The passage explicitly assigns both to the table type alongside row type. It makes no requirement to spell out each property in a declaration.

limitations: The rule supplies the documented type components without specifying defaulting or requirements for individual table categories.
The finding identifies the type components in the AS ABAP 7.54 overview. Category-specific requirements, key defaults, declaration syntax, and storage behavior are outside the cited definition.
